transcript: Hello Hello Hi sir Prerna baat kar rahi hoon. K Janvi Enterprises Private Limited se baat kar rahe hain. Haan ji boliye Sir aapka business profile aaya tha mere paas, main ise update kar rahi thi, toh main ismein dekh paa rahi thi ismein teen product aapne abhi apne teen ya chaar product daale hain, LED light chaser, LED chaser, touch sensor switch for mirror aur mirror touch switch hai na? Hmm hmm ji, toh main sir ismein puchne cha rahi thi ismein aapke number of products kitne honge. Achha, aur wholesale bhi deal karta hai aap ya manufacturing karta hai? Manufacturing manufacturing karta hai actually mere paas ek order aaya hua tha na touch sweet ka yeh jo aapne daala hua hai na mirror touch sweet iska ek order aaya hua hai aath sau bees ka order hai yeh hai na okay okay. Haan Hmm Ji par yeh order jo hai woh Punjab ka hai toh is location pe aap provide kar payenge Punjab ka ya sirf Maharashtra mein deal karte hain aap Okay sir, kuch information pehle mere ko aap confirm kar dijiyega. Yeh company ke jo owner hai aap hi hain ya phir partnership mein aapka business? Partnership mein wife ke saath mein. Partner okay and bulk buyer toh matlab aap hi toh negotiate karenge na ya aur kisi ka ismein aap dena chahenge? Ya. Nahi hum hi negotiate karo okay ek baar apna address bhi confirm kariyega sir ek 177 Akash Ganga Rahivasi Chitralisara Yahi hai aapka address? Haan ji. Okay, theek hai. Iske liye na sir, pehle aapki na profile ekdam poori update karni padegi. Like aap jaise yeh product ko sell kar rahe hain, aapne iska price daala hua hai Mirror Touch shoes ka ek hazaar pachaas rupaye per piece, hai na? Toh like iski na specifications aise nahi hai ek baar vo add ho jayengi toh aapke paas aisi hi direct inquiries aur zyada aane lagengi abhi jo hai unnees inquiries aayi hui hai hai na sir Aur kyonki hamare jo executive hain vo unke yahan ja raha hai aapke paas hi padta hai SR training karke shayad aapke maam suna ho Hai na? Safe product mein deal karta hai. Hum Subah ja rahe hain toh ek kaam karti hoon main ek visit kara leti hoon gyarah baje ke aas paas kal gyarah baje ke aas paas. Ji sir visit possible nahi hafte ke baad. Purul Ek hafte ke baad theek hai, toh agle birthday kara doon. Haanji, agle birthday matlab agla jo birthday aa raha hai. Agale hafte ka Monday meeting karta hai, vo gyarah baje aayenge, aapko vo inquiries dikha bhi denge, hai na? Vo aapko samjha ke dekhe, usmein deal karke karna hai. Toh birthday gyarah baje sir hai na? Theek. Okay sir thank you.
